source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO Mini Combo Extra 1046 emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-01.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_app_starts.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs at 0x9FE00800, sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 107 / 110, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE", 3.59 MB) to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) ("24000A001046", 11.17 MB) to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001; UART logging is muted in this release build).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", probes the RF front-end sharing GPIO 107 / 110 (M3031 at 0x20, AV2018 at 0x62, demod at 0x14), populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, configures the display engine's Full HD 1920x1080 CLUT8 G1 layer at 0xB8006A00 (DMA register-list channel 0x6088, 256-entry ARGB8888 palette at 0x6AEC), and without the board's anti-clone security IC displays "SW is not designed for this HW, please change back to offical SW!-----00000000000000 24000a00".

desc: Amiko Mini Combo Extra (System ID 24000A00) firmware v1.0.46 (2017-07-17) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3526A / C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses the 256 MB DDR remap (0xB8000220 bit 24, SEE at 0xAE000200), a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA), and the display engine's Full HD 1920x1080 CLUT8 G1 OSD layer at 0xB8006A00.
